screens.name: Main menu
screens.brief: Original matching angular sci-fi main menu on plain navy.

screens.name: Solo lobby
screens.brief: LOBBY inspired by Hybrid reference editorial composition. ORBIT ROYALE wordmark upper-left, top navigation Play active, Training, Settings. Center-right full-body frontier expedition operator with practical slate/graphite survey armor, rounded helmet and broad amber visor, lime accents, standing on a colony deployment pad with Ringfall lake and rings in sky. Left section 'SOLO', headline 'Ready for Ringfall', map 'Ringfall', exact population '1 player + 59 bots', small '60 combatants'. One lime primary 'Start match'. Quiet controls 'Callsign: Hunter', 'Edit callsign', 'Learn controls'. No squad selector, matchmaking spinner, friends hub, store or leveling. Preserve current original suit identity.

screens.name: Downloading assets
screens.brief: ASSET DOWNLOAD SCREEN. Cinematic Veyra colony/ringed sky art leads, restrained ORBIT ROYALE wordmark upper-left. Left headline 'Preparing Orbit Royale', stage 'Downloading assets', large thin lime progress bar with illustrative '68%' and 'Ringfall terrain'. Beneath show completed Characters and Equipment with check icons, Terrain in progress, Audio pending. Lower-left useful tip 'Carry a grapple to cross gaps and reach high ground.' Quiet 'Retry' only in a small clearly separated recovery example? NO, display normal active downloading state only with Cancel button. No fake online server or hardware messages. Percent is illustrative concept, not live progress. Strong readable interface without a giant enclosing panel.

screens.name: Preparing match
screens.brief: MATCH PREPARATION SCREEN distinct from downloading. ORBIT ROYALE wordmark upper-left, large scene of original unarmed colony drop carrier flying above turquoise crater lake under Veyra's own rings. Left text 'Ringfall awaits', eyebrow 'SOLO · 60 COMBATANTS'. Status 'Preparing match' with phase checklist Terrain ready checked, Equipment ready checked, Preparing bots current, Ready pending. Use an indeterminate thin lime progress indicator instead of fabricated percentage. Bottom tip 'No fall damage. Use your grapple to keep moving.' Small 'Learn controls'. No squads, resurgence, online connection or false downloaded totals.

screens.name: Match menu
screens.brief: MATCH MENU overlay over the existing Orbit Royale first-person POV, heavily dimmed full-height scrim on left. No settings shell. Large left title 'Menu', small 'SOLO · RINGFALL' and accurate concept note 'Match continues' for this illustrated mode. Unboxed left-aligned actions Resume selected in pale lime, Settings, Learn controls, Report a problem. Leave match separated by a thin rule and quiet danger cue. Right two-thirds shows dim Glass Basin gameplay and held rifle without visible normal HUD. Footer Back / Select / Open hints. No centered stack of cards, no practice analytics or unimplemented statistics. Only one overlay owns focus.

screens.name: Report a problem
screens.brief: DEDICATED REPORT SCREEN. Wide dark navy full-screen form with large 'Report a problem', Back top-left and Close top-right, no leftover Menu or HUD. Left two-thirds: selectable issue types 'Bug', 'Visual', 'Audio', 'Controls', 'Performance', 'Other'; Bug selected lime marker. Large description field labeled 'What happened?' with placeholder 'Describe the issue...' and 0 / 1000 counter. Right context area with optional attachment thumbnail of the Ringfall view and explicit unchecked 'Include screenshot' checkbox plus 'Preview before sharing'. No automatically sent position, logs, private data or fake attachment capture. Footer primary 'Save report' and Cancel. This is local feedback concept; do not imply an implemented online submission service. Selected field and focus visible.

screens.name: Learn controls
screens.brief: FULL-SCREEN LEARN CONTROLS GUIDE inspired by Hybrid lesson layout. Compact ORBIT ROYALE upper-left, title 'Learn controls', Close upper-right. Left vertical numbered lesson index: Move, Aim & fire, Reload, Inventory, Healing, Grapple, Vehicles, Storm; Grapple selected. Center/right large authored illustration of original frontier operator using wrist Tethercaster to swing toward a colony gantry above a basalt gap, pale lime cable clearly connecting to a solid anchor. Text heading 'Grapple', short instruction 'Hook onto solid surfaces. Release to keep your momentum.' Small progress '6 / 8'. Footer Previous, Next as dominant lime, Skip guide, Practice. No added building lessons or invented fixed key assignments. Plenty of space for instructions.

screens.name: Ringfall map screen
screens.brief: MAP SCREEN inspired by Hybrid map shell. Map dominates left 75%, separate bounded legend right 20%. Top title 'Ringfall', small 'SOLO · 23 LEFT', Close upper-right. Stylized top-down alien island, central turquoise crater lake, basalt highlands, luminous forest, colony roads. Exactly seven readable location labels Crown Observatory, Anchorport, Glass Basin, Bloomwild, Relay Nine, The Spine, Hollow Array. White safe-zone circle, violet storm outside, white player arrow and lime placed marker. Legend Safe zone / Ion storm / You / Marker. Small timer 'Next zone 01:42'. Footer Place marker / Remove marker / Zoom / Pan. No inventory, ammo, health, lobby navigation or separate gameplay HUD on map. Use map geometry reference when supplied.

screens.name: Victory results
screens.brief: VICTORY RESULTS inspired by Hybrid editorial results shell. Original operator right side holding AR-7 at rest, Ringfall colony dusk and Veyra rings in background, no gorilla. Left eyebrow 'SOLO · RINGFALL', lime small 'VICTORY', large ivory 'Last survivor', placement '#1 / 60'. One clear typographic stats row '8 Eliminations' / '1,240 Damage' / '16:42 Survival'. Quiet line 'Match complete'. Main lime action 'Play again', secondary 'Return to lobby'. No invented medals, personal-best claims, progression, squad placement, player purchases or rank awards. Restrained single-shot celebratory particles, not overwhelming confetti.

screens.name: Elimination results
screens.brief: ELIMINATION RESULTS using exact same composition, hierarchy and typography as victory shell. Dim Ringfall battlefield right, seated original operator silhouette optional. Left eyebrow 'SOLO · RINGFALL', small 'ELIMINATED', large ivory 'Deployment ended', placement '#12 / 60'. Stats '3 Eliminations' / '620 Damage' / '11:08 Survival'. Lime primary 'Play again', secondary 'Return to lobby'. Small note 'Review your loadout and try another route.' No resurrection/reboot, squad respawn, progression, cosmetics rewards or unverified personal best. Clear composed menu, no mock gameplay violence or body closeup.

screens.name: Reset settings confirmation
screens.brief: RESET CATEGORY CONFIRMATION. The Orbit Royale mouse settings screen is dim behind one compact centered opaque navy dialog. Title 'Reset Mouse & keyboard?', copy 'Restore this category to its default settings.' Two actions: Cancel neutral and Reset danger coral with readable icon. Reset scope is only the named category. Strong visible focus outline on Cancel. No global reset, no permanent account deletion, no extra overlay or heavy decoration. Maintain original settings shell behind modal.

screens.name: Leave match confirmation
screens.brief: LEAVE MATCH CONFIRMATION. Dim Orbit Royale gameplay behind a single compact centered opaque navy dialog. Title 'Leave this match?', copy 'You will return to the lobby and leave the current match.' Actions 'Stay' neutral and 'Leave match' danger coral. Visible focus ring on Stay. No unrelated account deletion, warnings about invented ranked penalties, purchases, or saved progression. Clear safe-area dialog and simple icon, same typography and palette.
